== Title ==

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、Ｘウイング、Ｙウイング、Ｂウイングのいずれかに配備する。１フォース使用して起動する。運命数を引くこと。大型艦の場合、運命数＞装甲値で命中。宇宙戦闘機の場合、運命数＞回避値で命中。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-158o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">強力無比な弾道弾。陽子を放出するエネルギー弾頭を搭載。射程距離は短い。エネルギー・シールドを貫くが、粒子シールドには防がれる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on an X-wing, Y-wing, or B-wing. Use 1 Force to fire and draw destiny. A capital ship is hit if destiny exceeds armor. A starfighter is hit if destiny exceeds maneuver.

'''Lore:''' An exceptionally powerful projectile with a proton-emitting energy warhead. It has a short range. It penetrates energy shields, but particle shields stop it.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4
* '''Printed subtype:''' Starship weapon

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
